name: Neither dead nor alive
source:
Will You Break Free or Succumb to Darkness?

In Neither Dead or Alive, you awaken as a skeleton brought back to life by a young, overzealous necromancer. But something went wrong—you retained your will, your mind, and your burning desire for freedom. Trapped within the ominous castle of your creator, your journey to escape begins.

Along the way, you’ll encounter cryptic puzzles, treacherous traps, and a cast of otherworldly characters. Some, like mischievous demon, may aid your quest—or try to steal your soul. Others might tempt you with the ultimate choice: give up and embrace the dark power of the necromancer. Will you forge your own path to freedom, or let the castle claim you forever?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3055510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你会挣脱束缚还是屈服于黑暗？

在《死或生》中，你醒来时是一具骷髅，被一位年轻而狂热的死灵法师复活。但出了点问题——你保留了自己的意志、思想和对自由的强烈渴望。被困在你的创造者的不祥城堡中，你的逃亡之旅开始了。

一路上，你会遇到神秘的谜题、危险的陷阱和一群超凡脱俗的角色。有些，比如顽皮的恶魔，可能会帮助你的探索——或者试图偷走你的灵魂。其他人可能会用最终的选择来诱惑你：放弃并拥抱死灵法师的黑暗力量。你会开辟自己的自由之路，还是让城堡永远夺走你？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3055510/]Steam[/url]]
